items.text:
I really enjoy this game, it takes some time to learn but once you do it is fun. You can play it for hours, put it down for hours / days and pick it back up again. I have a ton of hours in it and always come back to it. If you want something deep but cozy when you don't know what to do... it is great.

If I had one suggestion, bring in steam cloud saves so we can switch computers without having to manually move our files over. I play on a desktop and laptop, if you want to play the same save this is a manual process. Otherwise you have to play two separate saves.
items.text_zh:
我真的很喜欢这款游戏，需要一些时间来学习，但一旦你学会了就很有趣。你可以玩上几个小时，放下几个小时/几天，然后再捡起来继续玩。我在它上面投入了大量时间，总是会回来玩。如果你想要一些有深度但又舒适、当你不知道做什么时能沉浸其中的东西……它很棒。

如果我有一个建议，那就是加入Steam云存档，这样我们就能在不同电脑之间切换，而不必手动转移文件。我在台式机和笔记本电脑上玩，如果你想玩同一个存档，这是一个手动过程。否则你就得玩两个独立的存档。

observations.description: 缺少Steam云存档功能，需要手动转移文件
observations.evidence: bring in steam cloud saves so we can switch computers without having to manually move our files over
observations.evidence_zh: 加入Steam云存档，这样我们换电脑时就不用手动转移文件了

items.text:
NOTE: Cloud saves have been added mid-2026, the below negative point is no longer valid.

Therefore, I can now recommend this game as a perfect little deep simulation roguelike!



I would like to recommend this game, however I can't in good conscience recommend a game that is under active development in 2026 and doesn't support cloud saves even though the developer said they would "look into it" in 2022...

Refunded, but will happily buy again once cloud is supported.
items.text_zh:
注意：云存档已在2026年中期加入，下面这个负面点已不再成立。

因此，我现在可以推荐这款游戏，它是一款完美的小而深的模拟roguelike！



我本想推荐这款游戏，但凭良心说，我无法推荐一款在2026年仍在积极开发、却不支持云存档的游戏，尽管开发者在2022年说过他们会“研究一下”……

已退款，但一旦支持云存档，我会很乐意再次购买。

items.text: Very original game, about life as spaceman. Can say, thats space sim, life sim. Kinda like half sandbox, too. Not easy one, though - hardcore one. But there plenty of easy, cheaty ways, how to get credits. I certainly recommend it. specially for tech aspects lovers, with different space, construction, equipment simulation. Hopefully devs will add more handy "modern" features, like Steam Cloud Saves. Kinda annoyed, that i need to transfer saves each time from place to place (work, home). Also, more realistic will be to add cameras into station corridors... i kinda love to uninstall everything and sell it, lol.
items.text_zh: 非常原创的游戏，讲述太空人的生活。可以说，那是太空模拟、生活模拟。也有点半沙盒的感觉。不过不是简单的那种——是硬核的。但有很多简单、作弊的方法来赚取信用点。我当然推荐它。特别适合喜欢技术方面的人，有各种太空、建造、装备模拟。希望开发者会添加更多方便的“现代”功能，比如Steam云存档。有点烦的是，我每次都得在两地（工作、家）之间转移存档。另外，在空间站走廊里加摄像头会更真实……我有点喜欢把所有东西都拆下来卖掉，哈哈。

observations.description: 缺少Steam云存档，需手动转移存档
observations.evidence: Kinda annoyed, that i need to transfer saves each time from place to place (work, home)
observations.evidence_zh: 有点烦的是，我每次都得在两地（公司、家里）之间来回转移存档
